clips.title: The story
paras: Tinkmaster Overspark tasks Alliance adventurers with retrieving the memory core of Techbot from the irradiated ruins of Gnomeregan. The once-helpful mechanical assistant suffered severe brain polarization during the city's fall, causing it to run amok. Overspark hopes recovering its core will allow him to reverse the damage and restore his beloved creation.

Before the disaster that claimed Gnomeregan, Techbot served as a marvel of gnomish ingenuity. Designed by Tinkmaster Overspark, the automaton aided researchers with countless integrated gizmos and an encyclopedic repository of technical knowledge. However, the chaos of the trogg invasion and the venting of toxic radiation did not spare the machine. A stray electrical surge jolted Techbot's delicate internal architecture, completely polarizing its positronic brain into a volatile negatronic state.

Trapped within the contaminated halls of Gnomeregan, Techbot now wanders in a manic frenzy, attacking anyone in sight. Despite its violent malfunction, Overspark refuses to write off his prized assistant as scrap. He recruits capable operatives to track down the berserk automaton, extract its memory core from the metal chassis, and deliver it safely to Ironforge so the Tinkmaster can unravel the polarization and repair Techbot's mind.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: When our beloved city Gnomeregan fell, a rogue spark must have jolted my poor creation, Techbot. It once aided me and my associates with its countless gizmos and limitless store of information, but its positronic brain has polarized. Now it's negatronic... And Techbot's behaviors are reversed. It roams Gnomeregan in a frenzy!
But perhaps it can be salvaged. Perhaps, if you can retrieve Techbot's memory core and bring it to me, I can discover the cause of the polarization and fix my poor Techbot.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you find Techbot? Did you retrieve its memory core??

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, this is wonderful! Thank you, friend! I'll get to work immediately!!
Poor, poor Techbot... Don't feel bad. We'll get you fixed.
Now, where did I put that plug for my hydro-jack swivel spanner...
